item.title: Half of new parents experience intrusive thoughts of harming infants, study finds
item.description: A sudden thought of dropping an infant from a balcony is a common intrusive thought among new parents, research shows, and most such thoughts are not dangerous.

item.title: Food allergy policies vary by airline, podcast reports
item.description: A doctor found a sticker in an airplane emergency kit, highlighting inconsistent food allergy policies across airlines.

item.title: HPV vaccine recommendations may shift to single dose
item.description: Medical experts are discussing whether one dose of the cancer vaccine could replace the current multi-dose regimen for preteens.

item.title: Daily oral GLP-1 linked to similar weight loss across menopause stages
item.description: New analyses presented at the EASD annual meeting in Milan show similar weight loss outcomes across three menopausal stages with a daily oral GLP-1 medication.
